info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Product Sales Support API
info.description: The Product Sales Support API enables businesses to efficiently update and manage product sales support information. This endpoint allows clients to modify specific sales support details for products, enhancing accuracy and responsiveness to market needs. It caters to sales teams, product managers, and customer service representatives looking to ensure that all product-related inquiries are accurately addressed. Utilize this API to refine your sales support processes and better serve your customers.

patch.description: This endpoint allows you to update the sales support details for the specific product with ID PROD-700045. Ensure that you provide the necessary data in the request body to reflect the changes you want to make.

requestBody.description: Updates the sales support information for the specified product (PROD-700045). Provide the necessary data in JSON format to modify the existing details related to the product's sales support.
